title: Rules that set competition aside: $4.08 billion paid, a waiver recorded as an emergency

beats.text: February 25, 2020: the Mayor proclaims a coronavirus emergency.
The Board’s last file on it comes 833 days later.
Emergency rules let the City buy without competition.
